svg.title: Use the First 30 Days to Establish a Measurable Publishing System
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-search-portfolio-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Use the First 30 Days to Establish a Measurable Publishing System; subtitle: Ship an evidence-backed pilot, not a promised first-month revenue result.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four weekly milestones span Days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, and 22–30. Numeric values are milestone end days. Deliverable counts are sprint planning assumptions for the four-person core pod (1 FT + 3 C), not traffic forecasts. First-deal timing remains the canonical 3–12 months.; caption: Finish with a tested pilot, documented rights, functioning revenue definitions, and a funded next sprint. Ranking losses, slow audience growth, and revenue concentration remain explicit risks.; stages: label: Days 1–7; value: Select one site and one evidence-backed cluster; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Operator and editor map 30 queries, review ten competing pages, and select one initial site. Record expected revenue rails, rights requirements, and a twelve-month cash plan.; label: Days 8–14; value: Test two templates and commission ten briefs; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Technical contractor validates canonicals, indexing controls, mobile rendering, and analytics events. Editor commissions ten distinct briefs and completes the four publication checks.; label: Days 15–21; value: Publish ten reviewed pages with traceable evidence; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Release the pilot after editorial and technical review. Connect internal links, submit the sitemap, and sample GEO citations across twenty fixed prompts while recording engine, date, wording, and cited destination.; label: Days 22–30; value: Audit the pilot and fund the next sprint; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Review crawl results, measured impressions, referral events, and production hours. Test revenue reconciliation with clearly labeled synthetic records; rank refresh work and record cash needs without counting pending deals as revenue.
